desc:
Game is in early access. Expect Bugs

You can play up to 6 players

Like for more levels!

You wake inside an unknown place with no memory of how you got there. Soon, you realize you're trapped somewhere between life and Hell. The halls are filled with choices, and every judgment you make will determine your freedom. Constantly being watched by entities. Find a way out. Are u worthy?

Game was solely created by a solo developer, any bugs/glitches u encounter report them on our communication server or group! Enjoy!:)
